dry_s4_recheck_report.what_the_traced_pair_shows: both have uncached = 42. The skip has queued_uncached_ahead = 7,051 and the feasible one 0. So alert questions are skipped because of THE QUEUE AHEAD, not their own size, which is the alert-on-alert congestion the mechanism was built for.

SELF_INFLICTED_LOSS_GATE._claim: a skip of an instant that WOULD have made its deadline is a self-inflicted loss. Raw count and ratio reported; MATERIALITY IS NOT DECIDED HERE.
SELF_INFLICTED_LOSS_GATE.factor_source: cost_model_gate_d162.json, the committed fit's predicted_p50 0.2519 over actual_p50 0.2455 = 1.026069. The model OVER-predicts by 2.6 percent at the median, and alert requests sit at the LOW-token end of that fit, so this is the relevant direction for them. READ, not chosen.
SELF_INFLICTED_LOSS_GATE.NOT_A_TAUTOLOGY_UNLIKE_RUNG_4: the factor 1.026069 is the committed fit's own p50 and is INDEPENDENT of the skip decision, and the overrun distribution has a real minimum of 1.0073 rather than an identity at the decision threshold. Rung 4's zero came from a safety factor set equal to the measured worst bias, so its overrun was identically zero by construction. These two zeros are not the same kind of number and this one is a measurement.
SELF_INFLICTED_LOSS_GATE.A_STRATUM_CAVEAT_I_AM_NOT_LEANING_ON: the favourable 1.39x to 1.87x UNDER-prediction was measured on multi-thousand-uncached RECALL requests. These alert requests carry uncached of about 42 with large QUEUE terms, which is a DIFFERENT STRATUM, so that tail is not borrowed to argue the skips are safer than they look. The 1.026069 p50 is used instead, and the full ratio distribution is given so the count can be re-read at any factor.
SELF_INFLICTED_LOSS_GATE.VERDICT: REPORTED, NOT RULED. The materiality call is the user's, per the instruction.

step_4_negative_control._claim: the mechanism disabled must collapse to rung 3. The -off arm IS that control and it collapses exactly; there is no separate code path to disable.

scope_ablation._claim: 'alert only' is a measured cell and not a claim. -alltypes is r1's type set on this base and is NOT the headline arm.
scope_ablation.reading: with all three types the arm skips 30 recall and 36 assistance questions and its ALERT skips FALL from 1,869 to 1,291, because the recall skips change the queue the alert re-check sees. So the two type sets are not nested in effect and the alert-only restriction is a real design choice, not a subset of the same behaviour.

the_primary_bar_needs_a_LIVE_cell: late alert instants and alert attainment are SCORER quantities. A dry cell has no scorer, so the primary pre-registered bar (late alerts FALL against rung 3's 2,290 of 8,356 sent) cannot be read here and is what the s4 cell is for. The 1,869 dry skips are decisions, not scored outcomes, and the two are different registers.

cells_posted.why: the self-inflicted-loss gate returned 14 of 1,869 and the instruction is to report materiality rather than decide it. Nothing is posted pending that ruling.

harness_name_proof._what: HARNESS NAME PROOF on the POSTED commit 3466d599, added at the H100's request because the result had been reported in a message but was NOT in the committed JSON, so the gate could not be mechanical. This is the register distinction the project cares about: a proof asserted in prose is not a proof a gater can read.
harness_name_proof.method: the entry point's OWN resolution path replicated in a subprocess: `import arms`, then `import hybrid` (which registers the hybrid-* arms, exactly as run_live2_real.py does at :263), then `A.make_arm(name)`, which is :264. No server and no GPU are involved, and that is sound rather than a shortcut: the entry point BUILDS THE ARM BEFORE `_start_server`, a deliberate ordering whose own comment records that a bad arm name used to crash AFTER the server was up and orphan it, costing three idle GPU minutes on 2026-11-21.
harness_name_proof.register: this proves the name RESOLVES AND CONSTRUCTS through the entry point's own sequence. It does NOT execute a cell. The failure mode it is aimed at is the one that killed five cells on 2026-11-22: a name that imports in a friendly process but dies at cell start because only `arms` was imported and not `hybrid`.
harness_name_proof.why_the_negative_control_is_the_proof: a zero exit code on the real name proves nothing on its own, because a check that cannot fail passes trivially. The control confirms the instrument can SEE an unresolved name: `-not-an-arm` must exit non-zero with `unknown arm`.
